<script>

let allGuides = []; let filteredGuides = []; let currentCategory = ‘all’; const defaultImage = ‘/images/guides/default-guide.png’;

function getCategoryIcon(cat) { const icons = { ‘AI Security’: ‘fa-robot’, ‘Cloud Security’: ‘fa-cloud’, ‘Compliance’: ‘fa-certificate’, ‘Detection Engineering’: ‘fa-crosshairs’, ‘DevSecOps’: ‘fa-infinity’, ‘DFIR’: ‘fa-search’, ‘Identity Security’: ‘fa-id-card’, ‘Incident Response’: ‘fa-ambulance’, ‘Network Security’: ‘fa-network-wired’, ‘Red Team’: ‘fa-skull-crossbones’, ‘Risk Management’: ‘fa-chart-line’, ‘Security Operations’: ‘fa-shield-alt’, ‘Threat Intelligence’: ‘fa-satellite-dish’, ‘Vulnerability Management’: ‘fa-bug’, ‘Zero Trust’: ‘fa-lock’, ‘Email Security’: ‘fa-envelope’, ‘Application Security’: ‘fa-code’, ‘Analytics’: ‘fa-chart-bar’ }; return icons[cat] || ‘fa-book’; }

async function loadGuides() { try { const response = await fetch(‘guides.json’); const data = await response.json(); allGuides = data.guides; filteredGuides = […allGuides]; document.getElementById(‘totalGuides’).textContent = allGuides.length; const categories = […new Set(allGuides.map(g => g.category))]; document.getElementById(‘totalCategories’).textContent = categories.length; if (allGuides.length > 0) { const parts = allGuides[0].date.split(’ ’); document.getElementById(‘latestDate’).textContent = ${parts[0]} ${parts[1]}; } populateCategoryTabs(categories); renderFeatured(allGuides[0]); renderGuides(); updateResultsCount(); } catch (error) { console.error(‘Error loading guides:’, error); document.getElementById(‘guidesGrid’).innerHTML = ‘

Error Loading Guides

Please try refreshing the page.

’; } }

function populateCategoryTabs(categories) { const tabs = document.getElementById(‘categoryTabs’); categories.slice(0, 6).forEach(cat => { const btn = document.createElement(‘button’); btn.className = ‘category-tab’; btn.dataset.category = cat; btn.textContent = cat; btn.onclick = () => selectCategory(cat); tabs.appendChild(btn); }); }

function selectCategory(cat) { currentCategory = cat; document.querySelectorAll(‘.category-tab’).forEach(t => t.classList.toggle(‘active’, t.dataset.category === cat)); applyFilters(); }

function renderFeatured(guide) { if (!guide) return; document.getElementById(‘featuredCard’).href = /guides/${guide.id}.html; document.getElementById(‘featuredImage’).src = guide.image || defaultImage; document.getElementById(‘featuredImage’).alt = guide.title; document.getElementById(‘featuredCategory’).textContent = guide.category; document.getElementById(‘featuredTitle’).textContent = guide.title; document.getElementById(‘featuredExcerpt’).textContent = guide.excerpt; document.getElementById(‘featuredTime’).innerHTML = <i class="fas fa-clock"></i> ${guide.readTime}; document.getElementById(‘featuredLevel’).innerHTML = <i class="fas fa-signal"></i> ${guide.level}; document.getElementById(‘featuredDate’).innerHTML = <i class="fas fa-calendar"></i> ${guide.date}; }

function renderGuides() { const grid = document.getElementById(‘guidesGrid’); const displayGuides = currentCategory === ‘all’ && !document.getElementById(‘searchInput’).value ? filteredGuides.slice(1) : filteredGuides; if (displayGuides.length === 0) { grid.innerHTML = ‘

No Guides Found

Try adjusting your search or filters.

’; return; } grid.innerHTML = displayGuides.map(g => { const badge = g.badge ? <span class="card-badge ${g.badge.toLowerCase()}">${g.badge}</span> : ‘’; const icon = getCategoryIcon(g.category); return `

${badge}
${g.category}

${g.title}

${g.excerpt}

${g.readTime} ${g.level.split(' ')[0]}
Read
`; }).join(''); }

function updateResultsCount() { const count = filteredGuides.length; const displayCount = currentCategory === ‘all’ && !document.getElementById(‘searchInput’).value ? count - 1 : count; document.getElementById(‘resultsCount’).textContent = Showing ${displayCount} guides; }

function applyFilters() { const search = document.getElementById(‘searchInput’).value.toLowerCase(); const sort = document.getElementById(‘sortSelect’).value; filteredGuides = allGuides.filter(g => { const matchesSearch = !search || g.title.toLowerCase().includes(search) || g.excerpt.toLowerCase().includes(search) || g.category.toLowerCase().includes(search); const matchesCat = currentCategory === ‘all’ || g.category === currentCategory; return matchesSearch && matchesCat; }); filteredGuides.sort((a, b) => { if (sort === ‘date-desc’) return new Date(b.date) - new Date(a.date); if (sort === ‘date-asc’) return new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date); if (sort === ‘title-asc’) return a.title.localeCompare(b.title); return 0; }); renderGuides(); updateResultsCount(); }

document.getElementById(‘searchInput’).addEventListener(‘input’, applyFilters); document.getElementById(‘sortSelect’).addEventListener(‘change’, applyFilters); loadGuides(); 

<script src="/command-palette.js" defer></script>
<script src="../mobile-nav.js" defer></script>
